description:
Prepare a 3D printable asset of the Suzanne monkey head.

Requirements:
1. Clear the default scene.
2. Configure the scene units to Metric, length to Millimeters.
3. Add a Suzanne mesh and scale it so its height (Z dimension) is exactly 60mm.
4. Add a cylindrical base with a diameter of 40mm and height of 5mm.
5. Position Suzanne on top of the base and combine them into a single mesh using a Boolean Union operation.
6. Export the final model as an STL file to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/suzanne_print.stl'.

The exported STL must have units where 1 unit = 1 millimeter (e.g., total height should be ~65 units in the file).
